items.title: Anthropic Just Put Claude Inside Schwab and BlackRock. The AI Agent War Has Reached Wealth Management
items.summary: Anthropic pushed Claude directly into wealth-management workflows on September 14, launching Claude for Financial Advisors with connections to Charles Schwab, BlackRock and other industry platforms. It lets advisers pull client and portfolio information into Claude for meeting prep, portfolio review and documentation. That gives The Charles Schwab Corporation (NYSE:SCHW) a new way to deepen its […]

items.title: Forget BND: This $16.4B BlackRock Fund Pays 5.9% vs. BND’s 4.1% Yield
items.summary: BND has been the default core bond holding for millions of American investors, but a growing number of income-focused portfolios are quietly rotating into a competing fund that charges ten times more and holds riskier debt, yet keeps outperforming on the metrics that matter most to retirees.

items.title: Anthropic Deepens Finance Industry Ties With BlackRock
items.summary: Jaime Magyera, BlackRock senior managing director and head of US Wealth and head of Retirement, said advisers are using artificial intelligence to help parse increasingly complex capital markets after AI company Anthropic announces new ties with Blackrock. Magyera also said that AI is helping create more strategic customization for clients.

items.title: BlackRock's Fink Says AI Buildout Delays Limit Access to the Tech for Everyone
items.summary: BlackRock Inc. Chief Executive Officer Larry Fink says delays in the buildout of artificial intelligence lead to limited access. He spoke at the Canada Investment Summit on Tuesday.

items.title: BNP Paribas (ENXTPA:BNP) Taps ETF Veteran To Lead White Label ETF Push
items.summary: BNP Paribas (ENXTPA:BNP) has hired former BlackRock ETF capital markets executive Van Nugteren to lead its white-label ETF unit. Nugteren previously held senior roles at BlackRock and SpireBay Financial, focusing on ETF capital markets and product build-out. The appointment underscores BNP Paribas's plan to expand its white-label ETF platform for asset managers seeking outsourced ETF launches. items.title: Is Meta Stock Still The Self-Funding Ad Business You Bought?
items.summary: If you bought Meta Platforms (META) for its advertising engine, the engine still runs: revenue rose 28% year over year in the June 2026 quarter, and its Advantage+ automated campaigns keep growing. What has changed is where the cash goes afterward. The question for a holder is whether Meta is still the business you bought.

items.title: Bitcoin on Fire: Frenzy Intensifies as $6.8 Billion Floods Into Crypto ETFs in Just 6 Weeks
items.summary: Six straight weeks of institutional money flooding into Bitcoin ETFs pushed BTC up 24% in a month, but something just broke the streak and now the entire rally hangs on a single data point yet to print.
